run_pickle2_doctest: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python pickle support for the world extension class
test_pickle_world_greeting: test pickling and unpickling a world object to verify greet and secret number are preserved
test_pickle_world_reduce: test the __reduce__ method on a world instance to verify correct pickle protocol output
test_pickle_world_dict_error: test that pickling a world object with extra __dict__ attributes raises a RuntimeError
review_pickle2_safe_for_unpickling: review the __safe_for_unpickling__ attribute on the world class to verify it is set to 1
